title: Accounting & ERP Invoice Sync Connector (QuickBooks Online, Xero & NetSuite Adapters + Accounting-Ref Writeback)
description: Runnable Private App connector recipe for B2B manual-invoice and ERP accounting synchronization: verifies order.invoiced and invoice.settled CloudEvents, hydrates Order.invoice via GET /orders/{id}, maps invoices and settlements through plug-in adapters for QuickBooks Online (QBO), Xero (XERO), and NetSuite (NS), and writes back externalAccountingRef via idempotent POST /orders/{id}/accounting-ref.
